description.en: RunAttachAvatarEx(_chr, _avt, 30, 30, "J_07", 0, _msg, true, _lock): gives a Fighting Spirit with a chosen message. The BGM is stopped with a fade of 30, the function waits 30 frames, and the jingle J_07 plays while the message shows. No shipped script calls it directly.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
Message ID to show instead of the default one.
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.
